tools.name: huggingface_whoami
tools.description: Show the Hugging Face account this token belongs to and the token's role. Good first call to confirm the connection. Hub API: GET /api/whoami-v2.

tools.name: huggingface_get_credits
tools.description: Show the account's credits balance (USD), billing mode and the purchased, granted and monthly included balances with expiry dates. Hub API: GET /api/settings/billing/credits.

tools.name: huggingface_get_organization_credits
tools.description: Show an organization's credits balance and billing mode. Needs a token with access to billing for that organization. Hub API: GET /api/organizations/{name}/billing/credits.

tools.name: huggingface_list_organization_members
tools.description: List the members of an organization, with optional search by name. Needs an organization admin token. Hub API: GET /api/organizations/{name}/members.

tools.name: huggingface_list_notifications
tools.description: List the account's notifications (discussions, pull requests, papers, mentions), newest first. Hub API: GET /api/notifications.

tools.name: huggingface_quicksearch
tools.description: Search the Hub for models, datasets, Spaces, users, papers and collections with one query. Pass type to narrow the kinds, for example model or dataset. Hub API: GET /api/quicksearch.

tools.name: huggingface_search_spaces
tools.description: Semantic search over Hugging Face Spaces (demo apps), by what they do. Optionally filter by category and include Spaces that are not running. Hub API: GET /api/spaces/semantic-search.

tools.name: huggingface_search_papers
tools.description: Search research papers indexed on Hugging Face (hybrid semantic and full-text search). Hub API: GET /api/papers/search.

tools.name: huggingface_get_paper
tools.description: Get one paper by its arXiv-style id (for example 2310.06825). Optionally add comments or the submission deadline. Hub API: GET /api/papers/{paperId}.

tools.name: huggingface_list_collections
tools.description: List or search Hub collections (curated lists of models, datasets, Spaces and papers), by text, owner or sort order. Hub API: GET /api/collections.

tools.name: huggingface_get_collection
tools.description: Get one collection with its items. The URL slug is the collection's name part plus its id (for example slug 'semantic-search', id 'abc123'). Hub API: GET /api/collections/{namespace}/{slug}-{id}.

tools.name: huggingface_get_user_overview
tools.description: Show a public user's profile overview: name, Pro status and counts of their models, datasets, Spaces and discussions. Hub API: GET /api/users/{username}/overview.

tools.name: huggingface_list_user_likes
tools.description: List the public repositories (models, datasets, Spaces and others) a user has liked, with pagination. Hub API: GET /api/users/{username}/likes.

tools.name: huggingface_list_repo_files
tools.description: List the files and folders of a model, dataset or Space at a branch or revision, optionally inside one folder. Leave path empty for the root. Hub API: GET /api/{models|datasets|spaces}/{namespace}/{repo}/tree/{rev}/{path}.
